responsibility: Provides fallback dummy definitions for VxWorks-related target macros when a configuration is not actually targeting VxWorks. It supplies default false/zero definitions for TARGET_VXWORKS, TARGET_VXWORKS7, TARGET_VXWORKS64, TARGET_VXWORKS_RTP, and placeholder GOT-table symbol macros, allowing shared code and headers to reference VxWorks conditionals safely without requiring every target to define them.
